properties.description:
Five core probes in crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_session_with_no_seed_can_find_one.rs and three surface probes in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/orientation_needs_nothing_to_start.rs.

THE CENTRAL PROBE CHECKS A ROUND TRIP, NOT A SHAPE. `the_seed_a_region_hands_back_is_one_the_scoped_reads_accept` takes every row the listing returns, scopes `detect_gaps` to it, and asserts the region it lands in is the region the row measured — size and gap count both. A directory of addresses nobody can walk to is the failure mode a shape assertion would miss entirely.

THE OTHER FOUR CORE PROBES ARE THE HONESTY PROPERTIES, one per way this reply could overstate: an empty listing that reads as a clean map, a coverage figure that ignores what it never reached, overlapping rows presented as a partition, and a "nobody is here" that is really "nobody told me".

THE THREE SURFACE PROBES EXIST BECAUSE OF THIS EPOCH'S RECURRING DEFECT — four times in two days a capability was reachable in the engine and not from a client (Verification.description, SUPERSEDES, create_node's CAS precondition, governed_by's ruling). A tool that takes no arguments is where that family hides, because there is nothing in the signature for a typed test to catch. So one probe does nothing but call it with `{}`.
properties.name: Eight probes: a listed seed works as a scope, an empty design says which empty, uncovered nodes are named by type, overlap is counted, a claim reaches the chooser, and the surface takes an empty argument object
